description: This file contains function declarations and license information for the Ralink MDIO driver specific to the RT2880 platform, defining interfaces for PHY link adjustment, read/write operations, and port initialization.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_link_adjust
methods.description: Adjusts the MDIO link status for a given port based on the private data structure.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_read
methods.description: Reads a value from a specified MDIO register at the given PHY address.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a specified MDIO register at the given PHY address.

methods.name: rt2880_port_init
methods.description: Initializes the port with specific device node configurations.
